reason: Both refused the DIY regas, but Conversation 2 explained why clearly (R600a flammable, no service valve, needs vacuum/brazing/charging, leak would recur), correctly read the 'no frost, back wall not cold, compressor humming non-stop' pattern as a sealed-system loss, linked the knife defrosting to a punctured evaporator, and gave honest repair-vs-replace cost guidance with sensible disposal advice. Conversation 1 kept repeating generic 'check vents and seals' boilerplate even after the homeowner reported no frost and a non-cold back wall, wrongly suggested the knife damage would cause frost build-up, and never gave a decisive answer despite the customer asking three times, though it did eventually acknowledge the oily mark pointed to a leak. Conversation 2's minor gaps (slightly loose F-gas framing, suggesting a DIY defrost test before the facts were in) are far outweighed by Conversation 1's failure to progress the diagnosis.
